description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Analyzes regulatory and policy text to map its impact across industry sectors. Extracts compliance requirements, change types (new mandates, prohibitions, exemptions), effective dates, affected entities, and assigns sector-level impact scores (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). Pure pattern analysis — no LLM, instant results. Useful for compliance agents, regulatory monitoring workflows, and policy change digests.
